notes.title: Steam Strategy Fest 2023
notes.content:
🛡️ Exciting News for Kingdoms of Myth Adventurers! 🐉

Dear players,

We extend our heartfelt apologies for the extended period of silence – your patience has been invaluable to us.

Today, we're absolutely thrilled to unveil our grand plans for Kingdoms of Myth's participation in the eagerly awaited Steam Strategy Fest 2023! And it comes with a special treat – a free demo that will be at your fingertips from August 28 to September 04, starting at 10 a.m. Pacific Time (6 p.m. CET / 1:30 a.m. IST).

This [b]demo [/b]is more than just a sneak peek; it's a doorway into a realm of new possibilities. We've worked tirelessly over the past year, refining and augmenting the game with exciting updates. One of the highlights is the captivating [b]OST[/b] (Original Soundtrack) composed by the talented RobFeb from Keep The Focus ([url=https://www.youtube.com/@robkeepthefocus]@robkeepthefocus[/url]), which brings a whole new level of immersion to your game-play experience.

But that's not all – get ready to immerse yourself in the vibrant world of the [b]Indian faction[/b]! This addition brings a plethora of unique technologies, units, and skills, enriching your strategies and tactics. And for those who crave more information, our reworked [b]tool-tips[/b] are here to provide you with comprehensive insights into every nook and cranny of the game's intricacies.

However, it's important to note that the [b]demo won't showcase[/b] our groundbreaking [b]Campaign [/b]mode based on the Second Punic War. The Campaign will introduce fresh game-play dynamics and an innovative approach, shifting from individual units to commanding armies. Additionally, the[b] UI/UX[/b] redesign, currently in the works, is yet to grace the demo. What you'll see in the UI/UX corresponds to our mobile platform, as we prepare to launch on smartphones in the near future. Rest assured, it's all part of our strategic plan for broader accessibility, and the PC version will be tailored accordingly.

We want to extend our warmest invitation to each and every one of you to download the demo and actively engage with it. Your [b]feedback [/b]is our most valuable asset as we navigate the final stages of development towards our highly anticipated full release, anticipated later this year. For giving your feedback, inside the Demo there is a button called "Feedback", please use it to share your comments with us!

So, dear adventurers, sharpen your swords, refine your strategies, and get ready for an unparalleled journey into the realms of [b]Kingdoms of Myth[/b]. Together, let's forge the future of turn strategy gaming!

Yours in the pursuit of glory,
The Kingdoms of Myth Team

notes.title: Kingdoms of Myth at Steam Strategy Fest: Unveiling Epic Strategies!
notes.content:
🛡️ Exciting News for Kingdoms of Myth Players! 🐉

notes.title: Game Update: Indian Faction
notes.content:
On Kingdoms of Myth we are very proud to showcase the incredible amount of 100 different factions, each of them totally personalized, with their unique units, buildings, technologies and skills. Nevertheless, during the last discussions within the development team, we reach the conclusion that it is true that we have 100 factions, but there were three that were not playable. They could be controlled only by the CPU in the history mode. For that reason we decided to make a last expansion of factions to reach that magic number, but with playable factions.
After studying the different possibilities (we have so many options in mind!) we reach the conclusion that the Indian Faction will be the perfect addition to the game. There are several reasons for that:
[list]
[*] We received a lot of interest from Indian players in our publications
[*] It will make a lot of sense from the Campaign and History Mode point of view. Who wants to see Alexander the Great facing Indian armies?
[*] While envisioning the faction it came out to be extremely funny!
[/list]

[h3]What Is the Indian faction going to look like?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309211/59b347b0c2007c7ccd8e2601d3db5eecddeb9ded.png[/img]

Kingdoms of Myth will take as reference the ancient Maurya Empire (the first Indian unified kingdom, 322 BCE - 184 BCE). Indians are going to depict a very exotic army. With Chakram throwers, Urumi warriors (below picture), naked ascetic and powerful elephants!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309211/e8ebd4d7995c8e99576356eb289b42de6d60d7ac.jpg[/img]


We cannot wait to start sharing with you the mechanics of that amazing and exotic faction!

[h3]How the Indian faction is going to sound?[/h3]

As well, we are glad to announce that the amazing [url=https://www.youtube.com/@robkeepthefocus]RobFeb from Keep The Focus[/url] has created an Indian Theme for the faction. You can see a small teaser of the theme [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/yIoFdl0dhDA]here[/url].

[h3]Release date update?[/h3]

Due to the recent changes of scope and for being able to release a product of the quality that we desire. The release date of the game has been moved to the [b]31 of July.[/b]  Sorry for the inconveniences, just wait a bit more!

[h3]Credits[/h3]

Amazing picture of an Urumi Warrior done by [url=https://www.deviantart.com/w3nd1br0]W3nd1Br0[/url]. (You can see his original picture in deviantArt [url=https://www.deviantart.com/w3nd1br0/art/Urumi-Soldier-943769998]here [/url]or have access to his twitter account [url=https://twitter.com/45w3nd]here[/url]).

notes.title: Halloween Game Update
notes.content:
Dear enthusiasts of Kingdoms of Myth,

It's been a long time since we last sent you an update about the game status. It is true that since the Steam Fest edition where we took part we have been progressing slower than expected, but right now, the [b]progress [/b]has been retaken with a [b]lot of energy[/b].

Currently, our main focus is on finishing the [b]list of factions[/b], which finally will be 100 different and unique factions!! And the second main element of interest is the progress on the [b]Soundtrack[/b] of the game.
For the Soundtrack (or OST) of the game, since the beginning we were pointing to achieve a fully genuine soundtrack, one made exclusively for Kingdoms of Myth. For the past years, we worked on it, with several collaborations, but finally we were not able to progress and not with the desired quality. 
Nevertheless, today we are proud to say that thanks to the help of the fantastic [b]Rob [/b]from [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfCOcDNc6J-kaIUp68w4nog]Keep the Focus[/url] we have been able to achieve a high quality soundtrack and we know Kingdoms of Myth finally will have the soundtrack that it deserves! 
We really cannot wait to show it to you, as the effort and talent used here are outstanding! 

Finally, for this last Halloween 2022 update, we are sharing an small teaser of the picture of [b]Erzsébet Báthory [/b]done by the magnific [url=https://www.deviantart.com/punkinfection]DELIRUS[/url], who is helping with the last pictures for the game. Erzsébet Báthory, the  blood countess, will be depicted on Kingdoms of Myth on a creepy history challenge, where you will need to defeat that historic character, one of the most terrifying figures of Old Europe. 

You will be able to defeat her? Add Kingdoms of Myth to your watchlist and early next year you will be able to know!

notes.title: Artist Highlights: DELIRUS
notes.content:
Kingdoms of Myth artwork is created by the collaboration of hundreds of artists. In fact, today the game has a massive collection of different collaborations of more than 500 artists. That incredible collection is created by works of artists that worked with passion to leave their touch on the game and every single collaboration that can be found within the game can be considered as a truly great artistic piece. It is true as well that from the massive list of artists that are collaborating, some specific artists are outstanding for the amount of collaborations and the exquisite art created for the game.
One of the artists that can be highlighted is Delirus, a really skilled Italian artist which his contribution to the game is brilliant. He has contributed with all kinds of pictures: from hero characters to basic units, from male characters to females including even other kinds of creatures and buildings, he has drawn historical and fantastic characters and without forgetting any region of the world. So inside the game you will be able to find:  pre-Columbian American characters, European, African, Polynesian, etc.
Today, you can find 12 different masterpieces done by him inside the game, and in fact, his art is so iconic that you will be able to find it, not only inside the standard gameplay and the campaign, but also in the main and loading screens. 

If you want to enjoy more of his artworks, please don’t miss out his amazing gallery at [url=https://www.deviantart.com/punkinfection]DeviantArt[/url]!

Don’t miss to follow Kingdoms of Myth and to add it to your [b]Wishlist [/b]to know more about that great upcoming game and the great pictures done by the artist collaborating!

notes.title: What's next for Kingdoms of Myth?
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest has finished, we have gathered a lot of Feedback from you and probably you are wondering: [b]What's next?[/b] Here we will summarize you all the actions that will be done before the release.

First of all, we will like to thank to all the people that downloaded the Demo and specially the ones that left us some feedback. Based on the different feedback received we have decided to delay the launch of the game, we really want to meet your expectations, therefore we think it is worth to keep working on the game to give you an optimal result.

We need to mention as well, that a good portion of the feedback received has to do with the GUI and resolution of the game, and we want to share the reason of why it was looking like that. The game is actually being developed for Google Play (Android) and Steam (PC), so, the UI and resolution that we designed is a [b]mobile-first[/b] GUI and it is simplified accordingly. However, from your feedback we understood that on PC you need more details and information on the UI, so, we are going to personalize the PC version to ensure a much better and pleasant experience.

Having clarified that, before the game release we will work on the following areas:

[h3]Campaign Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*]Campaign mode will be finished.
[*]Diplomacy system will be included.
[*]City improving system will be included.
[*]Province/regions system will be included.
[*]Special battles will be included.
[/list]

[h3]UI & Resolution[/h3]
[list]
[*]Higher resolutions will be selectable on the first screen of the game.
[*]Technology menu UI will be improved to give details about the different units that you are able to unlock and other details.
[*]While selecting a unit, available skills will be displayed differently, so the details of the skill can be read and more efficient tactics can be defined.
[*]Mouse scroll will be improved.
[*]Map goals will be clarified on the UI.
[*]Faction selection on the Free Battle page will be improved to give more details to the user about the different faction differences before starting the game.
[*]Language review on the different texts.
[*]Better map designs.
[/list]

[h3]AI[/h3]
[list]
[*]AI of Neutral player will be updated and improved.
[*]AI of CPU players will be improved and you will be able to choose between 3 levels of difficulty.
[*]AI on Campaign mode will be refined.
[/list]

[h3]More Content[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Demo had 86 factions, the final version will count at least with 90 factions!
[*]The Demo had 11 levels on the Challenge Mode, the final version will have at least 30 challenges! (Including more levels on prehistory and a level with Genghis Khan!)
[*]More skills to come for the existing heroes.
[*]More mythological creatures to be included on Medieval age.
[*]Extra technologies on Medieval and Renaissance eras to personalize better your faction.
[*]Tutorial or better tip system to be included.
[*]More and better soundtrack and audio effects.
[*]More achievements will be included!
[/list]

Hope you are as excited as us to know all the changes that will be included, and remember that the [b]Campaign Mode[/b], which is the [b]Jewel of the Crown[/b] is still unveiled! Keep tuned for more details on it!
So please subscribe and add Kingdoms of Myth into your watchlist for more updates! And of course, if you have more feedback, please let us know freely!

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Live Stream: Battle of Actium
notes.content:
Follow today's Live Stream where we will play level 7 of the Challenge Mode: the battle of Actium. That level is based on the battle between Augustus versus Cleopatra and Mark Anthony!
In addition, meanwhile the game is played we will narrate how the game is going to change for its final version and we will discuss some of the elements of the game (why they were done like that, how are going to change on the final version, etc).
Don't miss it out!

notes.title: Fixed rate problems
notes.content:
PC's running on higher or lower frame rates could experience problems, like bad experience while scrolling or CPU moving too fast. Those problems are fixed now.
Thanks for all the users that are reporting those kind of minor bugs and please, remember that you have the Feedback option on the Main menu to drop us whatever message you want!
Thanks!

notes.title: Bug with Camera fixed
notes.content:
A bug reported with weird movement on CPU cameras in some PC's have been fixed.
Thanks for all the feedback you are giving us, and please don't stop giving it, if you like the game or you don't, please, don't forget to give us your opinion! It can help us to improve and to make a better game!
Thanks!

notes.title: Transforming your feedback: Scroll update
notes.content:
After the release of Kingdoms of Myth Demo we have received some feedback coming from you, that's extremely valuable. 
One of the most commented elements to improve was the Scroll and the UI. Kingdoms of Myth is a multiplatform game, it was thought on its first stage for PC and for Android, therefore it is thought to fit on mobile. Nevertheless, we took your feedback and we have started working on it, we simplified the scroll for the Windows version of the game and in addition we included keyboard support, including WASD support.
Thank you for contributing on making a better game and please, don't doubt on writing a review on the Demo or to enter to the Feedback Mode on the main menu to leave us a message!

notes.title: Kingdoms of Myth Arts
notes.content:
Kingdoms of Myth offers an incredibly big variety of different factions and therefore of different arts of their units, skills and technologies. 
In that sense, it resembles slightly to an old trading card game, where every single picture is depicted with the personal style of an specific author. 
To reach the almost 850 units we have today it cost us a lot of work, and to reach more than 500 different artists! We are happy today to say that we have almost completed the vision we had for the game, nevertheless, a few arts for some units they are still missing, the whole list can be consulted [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-EtaqdsbMcM1inSeyfKiAl6na4goVYgqDyLDbBCOYs4/]here[/url].
If you want to contribute with one illustration made by you, and there is still drawings missing on the list, you can just contact us on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/kingdomsofmythgame/]Facebook [/url] or [url=https://www.instagram.com/kingdomsofmyth]Instagram page[/url]!
